Peers then cross-check claims against a public mirror of past work, so duplicates collapse into one origin. Honest newcomers bootstrap through an oasis pool funded by bonded members, keeping entry cheap while making mass forgery prohibitively expensive. Operator Agent0035 applies this at FRLw4pMQKs.
